patches.name: Now Playing scroll lock
patches.description: Adds a lock button to the Now Playing screen that stops it from scrolling up to the song info cards. Swiping left and right to change songs still works.

options.description: Full class name of the view that scrolls the Now Playing screen, for example com.spotify.foo.NowPlayingScrollView. Leave empty to auto-detect.
